LESSON: VOLUME OF SOLIDS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.1 Area (8 lessons) • Area of a pentagon and a hexagon • Surface a
Topic 3.2: Volume of Solids

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Volume of Solids. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. calculate the volume of a triangular, rectangular, and square-based pyramid
2. calculate the volume of a sphere in real-life situations

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: VOLUME OF SOLIDS
Volume of Solids is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Volume of Solids problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Volume of Solids question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Volume of Solids question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Volume of Solids set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Volume of Solids.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Volume of Solids in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. calculate the volume of a triangular, rectangular, and square-based pyramid
2. calculate the volume of a sphere in real-life situations

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
